seoTitle: Connect a Namecheap Domain to Hostinger Hosting
metaDescription: Point your Namecheap domain to Hostinger by updating nameservers and adding the domain in hPanel, whether you run WordPress, a store, or a static site.
intro: Connecting a Namecheap domain to Hostinger hosting is a common step whether you're running WordPress, an online store, or a static HTML site. This guide covers changing your nameservers in Namecheap and adding the domain inside Hostinger's hPanel.

steps.heading: Log in to your Namecheap account
steps.body: Access your Namecheap account and locate the domain you want to connect to Hostinger.

steps.heading: Change nameservers to Hostinger's DNS
steps.body: Update the nameservers in Namecheap to the ones provided by Hostinger so DNS management moves over to Hostinger.

steps.heading: Add the domain inside Hostinger hPanel
steps.body: Log in to your Hostinger hPanel and add the domain there so Hostinger knows to serve your site when the domain resolves.

steps.heading: Wait for DNS propagation
steps.body: Allow time for the nameserver change to propagate before checking whether the domain is fully connected.

steps.heading: Verify the site loads through Hostinger
steps.body: Once propagation completes, visit your domain to confirm your WordPress site, store, or static site now loads from Hostinger.

faq.question: Do I need to change nameservers or just add DNS records?
faq.answer: The recommended method here is changing nameservers to Hostinger's, which lets Hostinger manage all DNS records automatically.

faq.question: Will this work for a WordPress site specifically?
faq.answer: Yes, the process works the same whether you're hosting WordPress, an online store, or a static HTML site on Hostinger.

faq.question: How do I check if propagation is complete?
faq.answer: You can check by visiting your domain directly, though propagation checking tools can also confirm when changes have spread globally.

faq.question: Can I keep my email working during this switch?
faq.answer: You may need to recreate or verify MX records within Hostinger's DNS settings after the nameserver change to keep email functioning.
